messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout: service=embedder, from=redwood/model-v2.7.4, to=redwood/model-v2.8.1, target=5% traffic (eu-west), change_window=2026-03-23T22:00Z..23:00Z, trace_id=tr-9f3b
release-manager: heads-up — release notes posted: https://go/redwood/releases/notes/2.8.1 :tada:
alex: quick question — is this the quantized q4 variant or full fp16?
sara: q4_0 variant, should be ~2.3x cheaper. Perf profile attached in notes.
matt: SRE, monitoring lookgood? any preflight alerts to watch?
sre-oncall: watching tail latency, 5xx rate, and token drop errors. Thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 10m -> call to pause. Latency tail > +50% for 15m -> notify.
irene: @sre-oncall can you also keep an eye on KV-cache OOMs? last week we saw a small bump with similar model.
sre-oncall: noted. will add kvcache.evictions, k8s-oom events to the dashboard.
alex: deploy-bot, pin config? We should pin control-plane to v2.8.1 only for eu-west sample?
deploy-bot: rollout created: rollout_id=rl-4452, pinned_regions=[eu-west], rollout_policy={phases: [{pct:5, duration:30m}], auto-rollback:true}
release-manager: holding on release notes minor typo fix — non-blocker but will update in 5m. Not blocking rollout.
sara: ops FYI — traffic shift starts in 1min. If anything odd, respond with "stop" or "rollback" in this thread.
deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 5% in eu-west. phase=running.
matt: seeing a small spike in 502s from edge-eu-3 (0.8% -> 1.6% over 3m). Could be noise.
sre-oncall: confirm. Looking at logs: multiple 502s traced to tokenizer timeouts. Sample log:
```
[2026-03-23T22:05:12Z] req=aa3f tokenization_timeout=true model_rpc=timeout(1200ms) host=edge-eu-3
[2026-03-23T22:06:03Z] req=bb2c 502 status downstream=model-gate
```
irene: that's similar to last week's microbake issue. Might be memory pressure in tokenizer pool.
alex: Can we throttle concurrency for the canary slice? reduces pressure while we investigate.
sre-oncall: Patching canary config to limit concurrency to 8 per-worker for eu-west. Applying now.
deploy-bot: updated rollout config: override concurrency=8 for rollout_id=rl-4452.
matt: 502 rate dropped to 0.6% over last 4 minutes. Good sign.
release-manager: I'd prefer we keep it pinned to 5% until next 30m health window. If it stabilizes, we can continue ramp to 25%.
sara: +1. Also will open a follow-up to tweak tokenizer timeout setting.
alex: Can we set an explicit rollback trigger: if 502 > 1% for 10m OR any spike in kvcache.evictions > 50 in 5m -> rollback to v2.7.4 automatically?
sre-oncall: set auto-rollback rules accordingly. I also added an alert to #eng-oncall with playbook link.
release-manager: okay keeping paused ramp. Next check in 20m. If all steady, go to 25%.
matt: one more datapoint — embedding quality quick-sanity eval looks fine on sampled prompts. No obvious regressions.
irene: creating a short runbook entry for tokenizer pool tuning and adding to the release notes patch.
sara: thanks. marking this thread: HOLD at 5% until 22:25Z.
alex: ack. If anyone wants to force a rollback now, say "rollback" here.
release-manager: no rollback from PM side, prefer hold and triage.
sre-oncall: continuing to monitor. will escalate if metrics cross thresholds.
deploy-bot: phase=paused (manual_hold), rollout_id=rl-4452, current_pct=5, note=concurrency-limited.
matt: FYI I pushed a kube-side limit to tokenizer-pool on eu nodes. Observability should show reduced mem pressure in ~2m.
sara: copy. Thanks team.
release-manager: thanks all — next update 22:25Z or earlier on signal. :eyes:
